scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run web:typecheck
scripts.test: npm run db:test && npm run auth:test && npm run jobs:test && npm run api:test && npm run router:test && npm run vault:test && npm run cost-gate:test && npm run approval-queue:test
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration --workspace @byok/cost-gate && npm run test:integration --workspace @byok/approval-queue && npm run test:integration --workspace @byok/router
scripts.dev: docker compose up -d --wait && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @byok/api" "npm run dev --workspace @byok/web"
